name: Recovery State
summary: Describes account-recovery progress and restrictions without conflating recovery with registration.

values.name: Requested
values.summary: Recovery was requested but proof has not begun.

values.name: Proof Pending
values.summary: Recovery proof is being collected or verified.

values.name: Proved
values.summary: Approved recovery proof has resolved to an existing durable identity.

values.name: Credential Reset Required
values.summary: A replacement credential must be established before normal access.

values.name: Completed
values.summary: Recovery completed and required security effects were applied.
